topic: Facility per user data structure discussion
summary_markdown:
Discussion focused on the implementation of 'facility per user' data. [p1] questioned whether a solution exists to avoid reconfiguring all users when implementing this feature, suggesting two alternatives: 1) Finding a general solution for implementation, or 2) Granting access rights to every facility for every existing user by default to facilitate a full migration.
[me] confirmed availability and suggested a short call to discuss the setup process.
decisions: A short call is needed to determine how the 'facility per user' data structure will be configured.
action_items: Schedule a follow-up call regarding facility configuration.
